title: E3 2012: John Carmack Interview
summary: Giant Bomb interviews John Carmack at E3 2012 about his virtual reality head-mounted display prototype. He demos it and talks about latency, depth and focus problems in VR.
why: HN links it as a primary source from the early days of modern VR, showing Carmack discussing his work before Oculus took off.

quote.text: Nice interview with John demoing and discussing his work
